@@U03141@@
It’s widely believed that I have many names.
But tell me, are there any British around?
They do a lot of traveling,
seeking out battlefields, waterfalls,
all kinds of ruins and musty classical sites.
This would be quite an adventure for them.
They know me, they can bear witness.
There’s a stage play where I’m known as Old Iniquity.

@@U03143@@
How did they hit on that?

@@U03145@@
I can't imagine.

@@U03147@@
sec
What do you know of the stars?
What aspects prevail at this hour?

@@U03149@@
(Looking upward.)

@@U03150@@
Shooting stars, one after another,
a waning but bright-shining moon,
and what’s more, I feel very comfortable here,
keeping warn beside your lion’s skin.
Why wander out of one’s depth?
Give us some riddles,
or at least a charade or two.

@@U03152@@
Only say what you are,
that’s riddle enough. Try, for once,
to unravel your innermost being:
“Needed by both pious and wicked men.
A padded vest for the first’s aesthetic thrusts;
a partner for the second’s wild adventures;
and both together merely to amuse the gods.”
translation:
@@U03141@@
人们普遍认为我有很多名字。
但告诉我，周围有英国人吗？
他们经常旅行，
寻找战场、瀑布，
各种废墟和发霉的古典遗址。
这对他们来说将是一次相当大的冒险。
他们认识我，他们可以作证。
有一个舞台剧，我的名字叫《老罪孽》。

@@U03143@@
他们是怎么想到这一点的？

@@U03145@@
我无法想象。

@@U03147@@
秒
你对明星了解多少？
此时此刻，哪些方面占主导地位？

@@U03149@@
（向上看。）

@@U03150@@
流星一颗接着一颗，
一轮渐亏但明亮的月亮，
更重要的是，我在这里感觉很舒服，
时刻保持警惕。
为何要走出自己的底线？
给我们猜几个谜语吧
或者至少一两个字谜游戏。

@@U03152@@
只说你是什么，
这已经够谜了。尝试一次，
解开你内心深处的秘密：
“虔诚的人和邪恶的人都需要。
一款符合第一审美要求的衬垫背心；
第二个狂野冒险的伙伴；
两者在一起只是为了取悦众神。”
